skill.summary: 当用户需要查询或分析以太坊链上数据时触发，包括：查询地址 ETH 余额、普通/内部交易记录、ERC-20/ERC-721/ERC-1155 Token 转账、智能合约 ABI 和源码、Gas 价格、区块奖励、事件日志、ETH 价格和供应量等。使用 etherscan-cli 命令行工具调用 Etherscan 免...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the etherscan skill for querying and analyzing Ethereum on-chain data.
- Supports ETH balance, transaction history, internal transactions, ERC-20/721/1155 token transfers, contract ABI/source, gas prices, block rewards, event logs, and ETH price/supply.
- Provides a command-line interface powered by etherscan-cli and Etherscan's free API.
- Includes detailed usage instructions, command reference, common pitfalls, and verification examples.
- Default network is mainnet; free API key required for queries.
